title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Rate Card — Volume Reduction of the Late Payment Charge for High ProBuild Spend
content:
The statement late payment charge on a Ridgeline Pro Credit commercial account is computed at a monthly percentage reduced for businesses with high ProBuild qualifying spend on their Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards record.

## Net ProBuild spend

The net spend is the business's ProBuild qualifying spend posted in the last 12 months, net of spend reversed in the same 12 months, as shown by the spend and spend-reversal lines of its Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards activity. The 12 months are whole calendar months counted back from the date the charge is assessed.

## Volume reduction

| Net ProBuild spend in the last 12 months | Account age | Volume reduction |
|---|---|---|
| At least 100000.00 | At least 60 whole months | 0.10 percentage points (long-standing) |
| At least 100000.00 | Less than 60 whole months | 0.05 percentage points (newer account) |
| Below 100000.00 | Any | Zero |

Account age is counted in whole calendar months from the account's opening date to the date the charge is assessed.

The volume reduction is taken, in percentage points, from the tier's monthly late payment charge percentage; the monthly percentage the charge is computed at never falls below zero.

## Boundaries (hypothetical)

- Spend lines of 112000.00 and reversals of 12000.00 in the window: net 100000.00, at the threshold.
- Spend of 112000.00 and reversals of 12000.01: net 99999.99, below it.
- Net spend of 150000.00, account open 60 whole months, Commercial Account Net 30 at 2.00 percent: the charge is computed at 1.90 percent; with the account open 59 whole months, at 1.95 percent.
